enterprise_scenarios.title: Strategy and investment portfolio
enterprise_scenarios.success: Compare objectives, initiatives, risks, capacity and expected benefits without treating forecasts as results.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Conflicting goals or funding limits require an accountable prioritization decision.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Market, offering and go-to-market
enterprise_scenarios.success: Map segment/need/offering/channel/journey to capability, acquisition assumptions and outcome measures.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Unmeasured demand or unsupported market claims remain assumptions.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Lead to agreement
enterprise_scenarios.success: Trace an authorized opportunity/quote through scope, price, promised service and accepted commitment.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Discount beyond delegation or incomplete contractual interpretation blocks the relevant approval.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Order to fulfilment
enterprise_scenarios.success: Reserve people/assets, run delivery steps, hand over evidence and measure customer result.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Partial fulfilment, late delivery and disputed acceptance route to cure/compensation rather than false completion.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Invoice, collection and reconciliation
enterprise_scenarios.success: Link commitments, source invoices/payments and reconciled posting references with independent approval.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Unknown payment result or unmatched invoice remains unreconciled; no blind duplicate transfer.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Source to contract and supplier performance
enterprise_scenarios.success: Compare suppliers, approve scoped procurement, record obligations and evaluate delivery/continuity.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Supplier outage, conflict of interest or expired authority routes a qualified substitute decision.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Hire, onboard and train
enterprise_scenarios.success: Model role/skill needs and restricted onboarding/training workflows with documented decision owners.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Missing human review or restricted personnel data cannot become an autonomous hiring decision.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Assignment, leave, handover and offboarding
enterprise_scenarios.success: Transfer accountable work and scoped access while preserving capacity and evidence.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: An absent/revoked approver cannot authorize new actions; orphan work is escalated.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Complaint, service incident and redress
enterprise_scenarios.success: Connect customer-impact case to commitment, process, deployed service and authorized remedy.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Disputed facts and irreversible refunds remain reviewed and reconciled.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Product lifecycle and software delivery
enterprise_scenarios.success: Refine capability into system change, required tests, released artifact and observed outcome.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Legacy/multi-repo/schema conflicts invalidate stale approvals and require safe recovery.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Asset maintenance and field service
enterprise_scenarios.success: Model asset/location/calendar, qualified personnel, work order and completed inspection evidence.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Unsafe machinery/field actions without certified adapter and authority stay unsupported.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Inventory, production and logistics
enterprise_scenarios.success: Represent stock/resource references, transformations, transfers and quality handovers in process scope.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Damaged/partial goods, uncertain sensor evidence and supplier failures stay explicit exceptions.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Obligation to operating control
enterprise_scenarios.success: Record sourced applicability/interpretation, owner, policy/control and independent operating tests.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Unsupported jurisdiction or expired evidence blocks a compliance assertion, not all unrelated business work.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Detect, contain and recover incident
enterprise_scenarios.success: Link detection to affected authority, data, systems and protected containment/recovery actions.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Break-glass is scoped, expiring and reviewed; cannot waive immutable denies.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Definition, authority and data quality
enterprise_scenarios.success: Resolve meanings/owners, trace property reads and require compatible producer/consumer contracts.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Replica promoted to master or missing lineage coverage creates findings rather than auto-corrected truth.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Access, retention, hold and disposal
enterprise_scenarios.success: Assess authorized disclosure/deletion scope and retain evidence of the decision and actual disposal.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Legal hold, residency or dependency conflict blocks disposal with reason; logs cannot leak erased content.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Audit and governance assurance
enterprise_scenarios.success: Select risk-based evidence sample, reconstruct authority/action/result and independently verify export.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Missing causal events or invalid signatures are disclosed as gaps, not repaired by fabricated evidence.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Reorganisation, merger and shared services
enterprise_scenarios.success: Compare target operating models and map transferred capabilities, roles, authority, contracts and systems.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Overlapping legal scopes or identity collisions need reviewed merge; history is preserved.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Disruption and disaster recovery
enterprise_scenarios.success: Exercise process continuity separately from platform restore with alternate qualified people/providers.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Recovery cannot duplicate commitments or resurrect revoked grants.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Human/agent augmentation and multi-agent delegation
enterprise_scenarios.success: Activate evaluated agent assignments and maintain aggregate authority/budget/checkpoint boundaries.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Prompt injection, unbounded recursion and planner self-approval fail before protected effect.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Knowledge reuse and organisational learning
enterprise_scenarios.success: Import governed sources, relate evidence to instructions/assumptions and propose reviewed improvement.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Stale, contradictory or malicious content cannot self-promote into policy or accepted claims.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Funding, tax, statutory and corporate actions
enterprise_scenarios.success: Model funding assumptions, obligations and authorized external-system responsibilities with evidence references.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: No generated model implies legal formation, statutory compliance, tax accuracy or permission to transact.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Cross-enterprise and public/nonprofit collaboration
enterprise_scenarios.success: Share a purpose-limited contract view across organisations with stakeholder/public-value outcomes.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: No revenue requirement for nonprofit; partner cannot infer hidden tenant or citizen data.

enterprise_scenarios.title: Retire service, wind down or exit OrgWard
enterprise_scenarios.success: Drain work, settle/transfer obligations, export usable model/evidence and apply approved retention.
enterprise_scenarios.adverse: Active effect, hold or missing export dependencies prevent false completed decommission.
